text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, Buena-san. Sighed so deeply... is 
something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Please don't suffer alone. Saving those 
who struggle is a Saint's duty, too. Tell 
me anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... It's really nothing. Sorry for 
making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It is difficult to speak of, is it not? 
But fear not. Even without words, I shall 
resolve your plight. —With the sacred 
power bestowed upon me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to hesitate. Shining light 
down upon all people is the duty of a 
saint. Now then, calm your heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What should I do... It's kind of hard 
to admit... that I just dropped my bento 
and turned the whole thing into a mess...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now—receive this sacred power, and grant 
me the answer that will guide all your 
worries and doubts into the light...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"'...Eat delicious food. ...Go hang out 
with your friends. That is the path to the 
light...!'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew. ...I see. Looks like that might just 
be the path to a solution. If you'd like, 
I can join you... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu! Yeah, if I go, I want to go with 
Desire-chan. I'm sure any worries will 
just blow right away!"
